The '''Jabiimi Military''' was the military force of the [[Jabiimi]] people. It originally consisted of a ground army and small stellar navy to protect [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] from a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] raiders seeking to steal [[Ore/Legends|ore]].

Later, several elite divisions were created with the Jabiimi Army to deal with more difficult tasks, such as the threat posed by the [[Lythian pirates]]. These eventually became so common that Special Forces became a third military branch.

At the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Jabiim Military split into two factions: the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic-allied]] [[Jabiimi Loyalists]] under the command of [[Orliss Gillmunn]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist-allied]] [[Jabiimi Nationalists|Jabiimi Nationalist]] [[Nationalist Army|Army]] under the command of [[Alto Stratus]].
